title: EventCameraConfig
description: Configuration for virtual event cameras: intrinsics, extrinsics (T_world_cam), and time offsets. Naming follows T_target_source convention: T_world_cam transforms a point from the camera frame to the world frame.

_comment.description: Human-readable comment for documentation purposes (ignored by validators)

cameras.description: At least two cameras are required for stereo triangulation

id.description: Unique camera identifier referenced in asset envelopes

T_world_cam.description: T_target_source: transforms a point p_cam in camera frame to p_world = T_world_cam @ p_cam. Equivalently, the columns are the camera axes expressed in world coordinates.

time_offset_us.description: Clock offset: camera_time + time_offset_us = scene_time (microseconds). Use to simulate inter-camera synchronisation error.

contrast_threshold_pos.description: Log-luminance change that triggers a positive event

contrast_threshold_neg.description: Log-luminance change (absolute) that triggers a negative event

distortion_model.description: Lens distortion model. 'none' = pinhole, no distortion.

distortion_coeffs.description: For radtan: [k1, k2, p1, p2]; for equidist: [k1, k2, k3, k4]

Mat4x4.description: 4x4 homogeneous transformation matrix (row-major). Bottom row must be [0,0,0,1] for valid rigid transforms.
